description: This file defines the 'ValueFormatter' interface within the OrangeHRM Maintenance module. It declares a method for obtaining a formatted value from a given entity value, to be implemented by specific formatting classes.

classes.name: ValueFormatter
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing classes to define a 'getFormattedValue' method to format entity values.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Method to return a formatted version of the provided entity value.
